descriptions.d19c_sky_load_80104e90: Read the "Land.SkyBoxResource" setting, load that sky box layer into +28 and a Y-mirrored copy into +32 with unit scale and the shared layer position; when the box has a "Sun" bone, store its translation as the sun position, set +68 and apply the sky's lighting kind from the 13-entry table to the light service object added to the light scene; then run 0x80105164 and the cloud and moon loaders and store the sky's cloud speed table index at +64.
